items.headline: Zema Global adds OTC energy data via Arrow
items.summary: Zema Global partnered with Arrow Energy Markets to feed AEM's OTC energy market data directly into Zema's Decisioning Infrastructure, giving commodity firms broader market intelligence inside existing workflows.

items.headline: EMIR 3 clearing thresholds take effect
items.summary: New EU clearing threshold rules under EMIR 3 enter into force, merging commodity and emission-allowance derivatives into one combined category and shifting NFC calculations to entity level, requiring traders to revisit threshold methodology before the deadline.

items.headline: IFC, Citi launch $2bn trade finance facility
items.summary: IFC and Citi announced a $2bn risk-sharing trade finance facility for emerging-market corporates and SMEs, with IFC guaranteeing up to half the risk on eligible transactions across Africa, Asia and Latin America.

items.headline: Forwarders consolidate as freight market shifts
items.summary: Scan Global Logistics agreed to acquire OIA Global, creating a combined forwarding group with over $3.6bn in gross logistics revenue, part of continued consolidation as shippers face uneven freight demand into 2027.
